name: Watch Machine Transfer
description: Once a day, first asks each API key of ours about itself (whether the provider still answers to it, and when it expires, for the Hosting tab and the cloud_account_key incident on each encrypted machine it opens), then reads from the cloud provider how much each machine this management node's nodes run on has sent this month, through every account it holds a credential for (the operator token and each connected customer account), and records it against the machine's allowance. A machine sending far more than its share becomes an incident on the node that speaks for it (Reconcile Incidents opens it and tells the superadmins): a day at more than three times its daily share, a month on pace past its allowance, or the allowance passed. The account's pool alert cannot see one machine running ahead while the others are quiet; this can. Each node's Overview shows its machine's month.
